user.title: Stalwart server
user.description: The Stalwart mail server (0.16 or newer) that receives the DMARC and TLS reports. Create an API key there with the permissions authenticate, sysDmarcExternalReportGet, sysDmarcExternalReportQuery, sysTlsExternalReportGet and sysTlsExternalReportQuery.

data_description.url: Address of the web interface, e.g. {example_url}

domain.title: Monitored domain
domain.description: The values below were taken from the newest report where possible.

data_description.own_ips: Addresses or ranges (CIDR) that legitimately send mail for the domain, separated by commas.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: Stalwart at {url} rejected the API key for {domain}.

error.cannot_connect: Stalwart is not reachable or did not answer with JMAP. Is it version 0.16 or newer?
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected or lacks one of the five permissions.
error.invalid_ips: Not a valid address or range.

data.foreign_min_count: Foreign sources: report from this many messages
data.notify_no_tls_policy: Hint once about a missing MTA-STS/DANE policy

data_description.own_ips: Addresses or ranges (CIDR), separated by commas.
data_description.dkim_exceptions: One per line: reporter and selector pattern, e.g. "google.com *ed25519*". Google does not verify Ed25519 signatures.
data_description.watched_reporters: Separated by commas, e.g. google.com. Leave empty to turn the check off.

error.invalid_ips: Not a valid address or range.

delivery_failed.title: DMARC Monitor cannot reach Log Notifier
delivery_failed.description:
{count} message(s) about {domain} could not be posted to the Log Notifier channel "{channel}": {reason}

Check that Log Notifier is set up and that the channel exists, or pick another channel in the options of DMARC Monitor. The messages are sent as soon as that works.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetches the reports from Stalwart now instead of at the next interval.
